title: ID0371670-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002550] Mainbreaker QA1 error flags on both DC outlets
description:
Hi Siemens Support Team,
the charger k6Nk5M shows error flags "Mainbreaker QA1" on both DC outlets in our OCPP backend. Please double check from your side if you can confirm the issue.
the charger has been rebooted twice, but the error persists.
Both outles were offline the last 12 hours.
Kind regards,
Marius Schneider
Software Version: v4.0.11-0-g0b7d164 (PRODUCTION)
OCPP Backend Connection: Yes

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0371670-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002550] Mainbreaker QA1 error flags on both DC outlets CRM:01811000195
additional_info.body:
Hello Marius,
I hope this message finds you well.
I wanted to update you on the recent issue with the charger.
The charger went offline due to some changes made to the PLC configuration.
After reviewing the logs, we found the following results:
The charger was rebooted at 11:43AM (UTC), which caused the main breaker (QA1) to trip.
11:48 AM, The charger had come back online and the outlets were available for charging,
12:00 (UTC) resumed its charging sessions.
The charger is currently healthy, and no further issues have been reported.
Please let us know if you have any further queries.
Thank you
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
